phase_name: Widen gap classification tolerance for already-mapped bases

objectives.description: Sample context windows of =/in/prec/subseteq unrecognized_gap entries and characterize the failure shape
objectives.note:
Wrote a debug harness reproducing classify_occurrence for all 38 entries (base_char in ={=,elem-of,precedes,subset-or-eq}, reason=unrecognized_gap) against the live corpus. Found: 19/38 are correctly-transcribed LaTeX math (
eq/
e/
otin macros) rather than corrupted text at all. The other 19 split into three sub-shapes NOT explained by gap-window tolerance: baier_katoen_2008 (6, wrong-file anchor matches -- Phase 5/6 territory), libkin_2004_ch3_ch7 (6, fidelity-gap unrelated prose -- Phase 8 territory), and 7 single-file wrong-location anchor matches (derijke_1995 x3, obendrauf_2024 x1, venema_1993 x1, yan_2008 x2 -- Phase 7 long-tail territory).

objectives.description: Widen classify_gap_text's tolerance narrowly, driven by sampled evidence
objectives.note:
Added LATEX_NEGATION_MACROS dict (base_char -> word-boundary-safe compiled regexes) covering ONLY the two bases with confirmed evidence: "=" -> [
eq, 
e], elem-of -> [
otin]. classify_gap_text consults it before the literal base_char presence check and returns the pre-existing "latex_macro" signature (already excluded from REPAIRABLE_SIGNATURES in literature-repair-combining.sh -- no write-path change needed). Deliberately did NOT extend to precedes/subset-or-eq: their only sampled unrecognized_gap entries were libkin false-positives, not genuine LaTeX-macro occurrences -- extending without evidence would violate the plan's narrow-widening constraint.

objectives.description: Add --self-test fixtures for each characterized shape plus negative fixtures
objectives.note:
11 new fixtures: 4 positive (real sampled gap text verbatim: 
eq, 
e inline, 
e after superscript brace, 
otin), 3 word-boundary negative fixtures (
ewcommand-prefix, 
earrow, 
otinvariant -- proving 
e/
otin can't match inside a longer macro name), 2 real-corpus false-positive-anchor negative fixtures (verbatim gaps from baier_katoen_2008 and obendrauf_2024 that must stay rejected as unrecognized_gap, not be swept up by the widened check). 32/32 total self-test fixtures pass (21 pre-existing + 11 new).

objectives.description: Dry-run, review diff, write with post-write verification
objectives.note: DEVIATION: no --write was needed. latex_macro is an already-accounted signature (excluded from REPAIRABLE_SIGNATURES before this phase) -- these 19 occurrences were never corrupted, so there is nothing to rewrite; they exit the residual ledger purely via reclassification. --dry-run over all 7 affected directories (derijke_1995, goldblatt_2003, obendrauf_2024, venema_1993, venema_1993_since, venema_1997, venema_2001) confirmed 0 proposed rewrites in every one. Verified the fix's precision via a differential corpus-wide scan (pre-phase-3 code loaded from the tooling-backups/.post-phase2 snapshot vs. live phase-3 code): for base_char in {=, elem-of}, 'unanchored' dropped by exactly 19 (478->459), 'latex_macro' rose by exactly 19 (2->21, the 2 baseline being pre-existing total_matches==0 fuzzy-window latex_macro hits unrelated to this phase's fix), and every other signature bucket (precomposed 257, bare_pair 18, control_char 12, absent 3) was BYTE-FOR-BYTE IDENTICAL -- proof of zero regression in genuinely repairable occurrences.

objectives.description: Regenerate residual-ledger-baseline.json to reflect the phase 3 result
objectives.note: Regenerated via the production tool (literature-repair-combining.sh --dir <d> --dry-run --ledger-json over all 60 PDF+markdown directories, read-only), merged with the 5 carried-forward non-repairable note entries from the prior baseline. Total 811 -> 792 (19 fewer, exactly the latex_macro clearance). unrecognized_gap: 69 -> 50. All other reason buckets (ambiguous_anchor 428, anchor_not_found 286, overlapping_edit 17, narrow_failed 6) unchanged, confirming no side effects outside this phase's scope.

deviations.description: Plan Task 4 called for --dry-run, review diff, then --write with post-write verification.
deviations.reason: The characterized fix (LaTeX-macro recognition) never triggers a corpus write for any of the 19 occurrences it clears -- they were never corrupted, only misclassified as unrecognized_gap. --write was correctly never invoked; --dry-run confirms 0 proposed rewrites, which is the expected and correct outcome, not a shortfall.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered post-hoc — no --write needed; see Phase 3's Deviations note in the plan)*

deviations.description: Plan's root-cause table listed all 38 entries under 'Gap-window/whitespace tolerance, base already mapped'.
deviations.reason: Sampling found only 19/38 are a tolerance/markup-recognition problem (and the real shape is LaTeX-macro notation, not whitespace). The other 19 are three distinct false-positive-anchor shapes that belong to Phases 5/6 (baier), 7 (single-file long tail), and 8 (libkin fidelity) respectively -- confirmed the plan's own verification wording ('cleared OR individually justified') anticipates exactly this kind of partial clearance.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — root-cause table's single bucket split into 4 sub-causes on sampling; see plan Deviations note for the full per-directory breakdown)*
